name: EarlyHunt
conditions: Free Launch ($0) requires the EarlyHunt badge on your site.
Free-tier outbound links are nofollow by default — only Top-3 daily winners can earn dofollow.
requirements: Product/startup launches; a daily launch board in the Aura++/IndieHunt family of launch platforms.
Badge on your site for the free tier.
preparation: Project name, URL, tagline, description, logo, category.
EarlyHunt badge embed for free tier.

Plan choice: Free (badge, nofollow, top-3 earns dofollow) / Premium $19 one-time (guaranteed dofollow, site-wide ad slots for 7 live days, Launch Kit graphics, launch blog post, social promotion, skip queue).
workflow: Choose Free or Premium ($19) launch tier.
Free: install the badge, submit, and compete in the daily ranking — Top 3 earns the dofollow link.
Premium: guaranteed dofollow plus 7 days of site-wide ad slots and launch assets.
watchFor: Free tier is nofollow unless you rank Top-3 — the 'free dofollow' is competitive, not guaranteed.
Premium's real perks are the guaranteed dofollow + skip queue + ad slots; evaluate vs $19.
Launch Kit graphics / launch blog are content upsells.
The submit/pricing pages expose an AI-friendly .md mirror — clean source of truth.
countsAsLive: The product appears on earlyhunt.com's daily launch ranking for its launch date with a public listing page.
unknowns: Whether an account is required (submit page didn't expose auth state).
Free queue length / how far out launches can be scheduled.
